title: Build the public landing page and inquiry form
requirements: Create a dependency-free responsive Russian static landing under apps/web with index.html, stylesheet and browser JavaScript. It is a client interface only: do not introduce a bundler, server, hosting, runtime configuration or new package dependency.

Load the public catalog from GET /api/v1/public/catalog and render only returned active services/options, their duration and price. Fixed prices use RUB formatting; negotiated options show «По договорённости». Do not hardcode a duplicate commercial price list or invent an address, phone number, map URL, photos, age threshold or participation guarantee.

Present the accepted customer information in clear Russian: instruction before mounting, clothing/visit rules supplied by the catalog, beginner-friendly formats, children’s options, trainer approval for an active gallop ride, and the approximately 110 kg weight notice as a discussion point rather than an automatic gate. Show the catalog location link only when supplied by the API.

Implement an accessible inquiry form with service option, name, contact kind/value, participant count, desired date/time, experience and optional comment. It must request a submission token then submit to POST /api/v1/public/inquiries with Idempotency-Key, retain the same token/key during a retryable network outcome, preserve UTM labels from the landing URL, and distinguish accepted receipt from an unconfirmed booking.

Render loading, unavailable, validation and retryable error states without exposing server diagnostics or claiming payment/booking confirmation. Unknown API data must be escaped before it enters the DOM. The page must work without tracking scripts, analytics SDKs, external fonts or external images.

Add focused offline structural tests for the public contract: no hardcoded commercial catalog, expected endpoints/form fields and the required non-gate informational wording. Do not call a real server, use credentials, deploy or alter backend code.
acceptance: A visitor can understand the service conditions, read the live catalog, choose an option and submit a prepared request without being promised a confirmed slot or automated eligibility decision.
The form uses the accepted public token/idempotency protocol and retains the data required for a safe retry.
Focused offline tests, scope and whitespace checks pass with no external network calls.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted public information funnel using the existing catalog and submission contracts without a hosting or backend change.
